## Key points {.unnumbered}

- A vector holds values of one type; mixing types can coerce its elements.
- Name elements to select them by name as well as by position.
- Positive indices select elements, negative indices exclude them, and logical indices keep matches.
- Use `is.na()` to find missing values and `na.rm = TRUE` to exclude them from summaries.
